footnotes: Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. summary: The company had no revenue in 2025. The operating loss widened to $48.3M from $33.4M.
The net loss narrowed to $38.2M, or −$0.72 per share, from $55.2M. Operating cash flow was −$38.3M and free cash flow −$38.9M, versus −$27.0M.
sources: Candel Therapeutics, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)

risks: Our future operating results could differ materially from the results described in this Annual Report on Form 10-K due to the risks…
We have incurred significant operating losses since our inception and anticipate that we will incur continued losses for the foreseeable future
We will need to raise substantial additional funding, which may not be available on acceptable terms, or at all
We have incurred indebtedness, and we may incur additional indebtedness, which could adversely affect our financial condition
The terms of the RTW Purchase Agreement place restrictions on our operating and financial flexibility…
strategy: Advance the late-stage development of, and seek regulatory approval for, our product candidate, aglatimagene, in newly diagnosed…
Advance the development of aglatimagene in stage III/IV NSCLC patients with inadequate responses to SoC immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI)
Establish strategic partnerships to maximize the value of our current and future product candidates
Ensure commercial-scale manufacturing of our product candidates
